proposals.evidence: DEDR5151: Irula dāru explicitly means who; Kannada dāru and Kodagu dā·rï occur in the same interrogative article. Pattapu d̪āɹu closely matches the initial dental, long vowel and rhotic formation. This specific d-initial member supports the whole-article link even though Tamil yā/e- forms dominate the head. Whole-article family membership is proposed; inheritance versus local transmission remains subject to review. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR3939: Tamil paiyaṉ/paiyal denote boy, while Tulu paiyya denotes child and paiyyè child or boy. Pattapu paii is proposed as a contracted member of this family, with its written vowel sequence retained. The absence of an overt glide or final consonant is an explicit limitation; no spelling correction or exact-form claim is made. Whole-article family membership is proposed; inheritance versus local transmission remains subject to review. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

The full female noun is compared, rather than assigning the record to a bare small adjective or inventing a new derivational suffix node. Whole-article family membership is proposed; inheritance versus local transmission remains subject to review. Pattapu monu is proposed with rounded o and a plain nasal retained; absence of final l is supported by these sand forms, rather than borrowing the earth sense from subsection(a). Whole-article family membership and inheritance versus local transmission remain subject to review. proposals.evidence: DEDR3045 explicitly records Tamil taṇṇīr/taṇṇi cold water, water and Malayalam taṇṇīr/taṇṇi cold/drinking water, beside taṇ cold; DEDR3690 gives nīr water. Proposed ordered historical components are cold3045 plus water3690. Pattapu θani compares with the attested shortened taṇṇi form, retaining θ and its single non-retroflex n. The lexicalized water meaning is preserved; the proposal does not assert that this is synchronically transparent in Pattapu or establish an immediate donor route.
